Title: Successful search for an existing product
Steps: 1. Click '¿Qué buscas hoy?'. 2. Type 'celular'. 3. Press Enter.
Expected_Result: Redirects to /search?text=celular and displays results with prices and Agregar button.

Title: Search with a non-existent term
Steps: 1. Click search bar. 2. Type 'xyzqwerty99999'. 3. Press Enter.
Expected_Result: Displays friendly no-results message without HTTP 500 errors or blank screen.

Title: Search with empty or whitespace-only input
Steps: 1. Click search bar. 2. Enter spaces. 3. Press Enter.
Expected_Result: Does not navigate to a broken page; keeps overlay or shows validation.

Title: Filter by brand and sort by lowest price
Steps: 1. Click Filtrar > Marca > SAMSUNG > Apply. 2. Click Ordenar > Precio: menor a mayor > Apply.
Test_Data: Brand: SAMSUNG; Sort: Price low to high
Expected_Result: List filtered to SAMSUNG only and sorted ascending by price.

Title: Add product directly from search results
Steps: 1. Locate product card. 2. Click orange 'Agregar' button.
Expected_Result: Mi carrito badge increments from 0 to 1 without full page reload.

Title: Add product from PDP skipping Kombos & add-ons
Preconditions: User on PDP of an available smartphone
Steps: 1. Select variant & Envio gratis. 2. Click Agregar al carrito. 3. Click Agregar sin Kombo. 4. Click Continuar.
Expected_Result: Closes upsell modals and increments Mi carrito counter.

Title: Update quantity and remove product in /cart
Expected_Result: Recalculates Subtotal/Total at 2x and empties cart upon removal.
